newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Noel to issue ADRs -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Noel to issue ADRs -- paper.

text.p: Industrias Alimenticias Noel, Colombia's largest hard candy and biscuit producer, has decided to issue $125 million in American Depositary Receipts, local news reports said Friday.
According to Medellin's El Colombiano newspaper, the share deal would mark the second issuance of ADRs by a firm belonging to the powerful and highly diversified Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate.
Spokesmen for Noel could not be reached for immediate comment on the report, which said the ADRs would help finance $250 million in new investments by the company.
